name: CustomXMLNodes
description: Contains a collection of CustomXMLNode objects representing the XML nodes in a document.
remarks: The Attributes and the ChildNodes properties return collections of nodes of this type.
example:
Sub CustomXmlNodes()
    Dim cxp1 As CustomXMLPart
    Dim cxns As CustomXMLNodes

    With ActiveDocument

        ' Returns the first custom xml part with the given root namespace.
        Set cxp1 = .CustomXMLParts("urn:invoice:namespace")

        ' Get custom xml nodes using XPath.
        Set cxns = cxp1.SelectNodes("//*[@unitPrice > 20]")

    End With

End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the CustomXMLNodes object. Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the CustomXMLNodes object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the CustomXMLNodes object. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a count of the number of CustomXMLNode objects in a CustomXMLNodes collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a CustomXMLNode object from the CustomXMLNodes collection. Read-only.
